properties.evidence: Option (a) here — a proxy-injected identity header — runs into that decision's recorded rejection of deriving identity from request headers. The objection was about the MCP client's OWN headers, which are caller-supplied, and a trusted proxy's injected header is a different object; but this option cannot be taken without that distinction being made deliberately, and option (b) is that decision's mint-and-carry shape applied to contributors instead of seats.
